svg.title: Berwick family place clues: homes, textile work, and Pine Grove Cemetery
svg.desc: A schematic street-clue diagram, not a scale map. Family memory places elder Kreischers at Vine and 13th and Sponenbergs on Second Street, without house numbers or dates. A 1941 Federal Register notice puts the Duplan mill at 11th and Mulberry. A 1997 on-site reading places Edward and Jennie Sponenberg at Pine Grove Cemetery at Market and Ninth.
